story.text: 한옥마을 골목 안, 나무 간판이 걸린 작은 치킨집 앞에 하늘이 먼저 자리를 잡고 앉아 있었다.
story.reading: han-ok-ma-eul gol-mok an, na-mu gan-pan-i geol-lin jak-eun chi-kin-jib ap-e ha-neul-i meon-jeo ja-ri-reul jap-go anj-a iss-eot-da.
story.en: In an alley of Hanok Village, in front of a small chicken place with a wooden sign, Haneul had already claimed a seat and was sitting there.

story.text: "왔으면 앉아. 뭐 마실지는 벌써 시켜놨어." 그가 턱짓으로 맥주 두 잔을 가리켰다. 시원한 거품이 잔 위로 넘칠 듯 담겨 있었다.
story.reading: wass-eu-myeon anj-a. mwo ma-sil-ji-neun beol-sseo si-kyeo-nwass-eo. geu-ga teok-jis-eu-ro maek-ju du jan-eul ga-ri-kyeot-da. si-won-han geo-pum-i jan wi-ro neom-chil deut dam-gyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: "You're here, so sit. I already ordered what we're drinking." He nodded toward two mugs of beer with his chin. Cold, refreshing foam sat brimming right at the rim.

story.text: "순살로 시켰어. 너 뼈 발라내는 거 귀찮아하잖아." 무심하게 던진 말이었지만, 내 취향을 정확히 기억하고 있었다.
story.reading: sun-sal-lo si-kyeoss-eo. neo ppyeo bal-la-nae-neun geo gwi-chan-a-ha-jan-a. mu-sim-ha-ge deon-jin mal-i-eot-ji-man, nae chwi-hyang-eul jeong-hwak-hi gi-eok-ha-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: "I ordered it boneless. You always hate picking bones apart." He said it offhandedly, but he'd remembered exactly what I liked.

story.text: 치킨이 나오자 그는 잔부터 들어 올렸다. "건배. 오랜만에 얼굴 본 기념으로." 잔이 부딪히는 소리가 좁은 가게 안에 청량하게 퍼졌다.
story.reading: chi-kin-i na-o-ja geu-neun jan-bu-teo deul-eo ol-lyeot-da. geon-bae. o-raen-man-e eol-gul bon gi-nyeom-eu-ro. jan-i bu-di-chi-neun so-ri-ga job-eun ga-ge an-e cheong-nyang-ha-ge peo-jyeot-da.
story.en: When the chicken arrived, he raised his glass first. "Cheers. To finally seeing your face again." The clink of our glasses rang out crisply through the small restaurant.

story.text: "안주는 이걸로 됐고, 너 요즘 뭐 힘든 거 없어?" 대수롭지 않은 척 물었지만, 눈은 나를 똑바로 보고 있었다.
story.reading: an-ju-neun i-geol-lo dwaet-go, neo yo-jeum mwo him-deun geo eop-seo? dae-su-rop-ji anh-eun cheok mul-eot-ji-man, nun-eun na-reul ttok-ba-ro bo-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: "This is plenty for a drinking snack — anyway, is anything rough going on with you lately?" He asked it like it was nothing, but his eyes were watching me straight on.

story.text: "없어, 없어. 그냥 먹자." 나는 얼버무리며 웃었다. 그는 더 캐묻지 않고, 대신 잔을 다시 채워줬다. "그래, 오늘은 그냥 한잔하자."
story.reading: eop-seo, eop-seo. geu-nyang meok-ja. na-neun eol-beo-mu-ri-myeo us-eot-da. geu-neun deo kae-mut-ji anh-go, dae-sin jan-eul da-si chae-wo-jwot-da. geu-rae, o-neul-eun geu-nyang han-jan-ha-ja.
story.en: "Nothing, nothing. Let's just eat." I laughed it off vaguely. He didn't press further, and instead refilled my glass. "Alright. Let's just have a drink tonight."

story.text: 뼈다귀가 쌓여가는 접시 위로, 우리는 별거 아닌 이야기를 주고받았다. 오랜만인데도 하나도 어색하지 않은 밤이었다.
story.reading: ppyeo-da-gwi-ga sso-a-ga-neun jeop-si wi-ro, u-ri-neun byeol-geo a-nin i-ya-gi-reul ju-go-bad-at-da. o-raen-man-in-de-do ha-na-do eo-saek-ha-ji anh-eun bam-i-eot-da.
story.en: Over a plate piling up with bones, we traded small, meaningless talk. Even after so long apart, the night didn't feel awkward at all.

words.example_en: We raised our glasses and toasted.

words.meaning: food eaten with alcohol, drinking snack
words.example_en: Beer just isn't complete without something to eat alongside it.
This beer is really cold and refreshing.
Should we grab a drink tonight?
